userStories.title: Map Rorca Specs to Linear Projects (Not Just Issues)
userStories.description: Linear Projects (not Cycles) are the right abstraction for mapping a Rorca spec. A Project in Linear is a cross-team initiative with a start/end date, status, and its own issue list — exactly what a spec represents. When a Rorca spec is approved, create a Linear Project named after the spec title. Each Rorca story becomes a Linear sub-issue under that project. When a story passes, the sub-issue is marked Done. When all stories pass, the project is marked Completed. This is a higher-fidelity integration than issue-level syncing alone because PMs get progress visibility in Linear's Projects view, not just the issue list. The existing story_linear_map table (INT-053) maps story_id + run_id to linear_issue_id — extend with a spec_to_project_map table that maps spec_id to linear_project_id for project lifecycle management.
acceptanceCriteria: New DB migration: spec_linear_projects table (id, spec_id VARCHAR, workspace_id VARCHAR, linear_project_id VARCHAR, linear_project_url VARCHAR, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ)

When POST /api/specs/:id/approve is called and Linear is connected for the workspace, create a Linear Project via POST /graphql (Linear's GraphQL API) with name=spec.title, description=spec.description, teamId from workspace Linear settings
POST /api/linear/projects endpoint creates a Linear Project and stores the mapping in spec_linear_projects
Linear Project status lifecycle: 'Planned' on spec approval → 'In Progress' on first story started → 'Completed' when run status = 'completed'
Project status updated via PATCH to Linear's GraphQL API when WAL events arrive (story_started, run_finished)
Each story in the spec creates a Linear sub-issue under the project (reuses existing INT-012 story import logic but targets the project's issue list)
spec_to_project_map referenced in Linear webhook handler (INT-014) — inbound Linear issue updates propagate to Rorca story status
Settings > Integrations > Linear shows 'Project sync: enabled/disabled' toggle separate from issue sync
When spec is rejected, the Linear Project is archived (not deleted) via Linear GraphQL API
GET /api/workspaces/:id/integrations/linear/projects returns list of synced projects with spec_id, project status, and Linear URL
Linear API errors are non-fatal — logged to integration_audit_log, shown in Settings > Integrations health dashboard (INT-004)
